turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Was Owen heard before you entered that zero?
I don't think this is productive.
Productive. Answer the question: was he heard first, yes or no?
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
You asked for this meeting. Withdraw the zero, in writing, or my next stop is the principal's office.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.
I will. Before you go: is anything on Owen's record right now?
